premise: Rabbit's ears hear the rain long before anyone sees a cloud, and he gathers his friends under Mushroom just in time.
inspiration: Chicken Little (folk), turned: the warning is true, it is given calmly, and it brings everyone together instead of running around.
lesson: Listening carefully helps you look after others.
learning: Rabbits turn their long ears to hear sounds far away

en-US.title: Rabbit Hears the Rain
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 10s} It was a sunny day, and {frog:enter} Frog {frog:hop} {frog:face sleeping} was sunbathing. Suddenly, {rabbit:enter} {rabbit:live} Rabbit's ears went up. He listened. He looked left, and he looked right… and nibbled a clover leaf, to think. [whispers] I can hear it, he said. Rain, far, far away. {sfx:far-rain solo} {frog:face normal} Frog looked at the sky. Not one cloud! But Rabbit turned his long ears this way and that. It's coming, he said. {canvas:clouds 0.8 30s} And it was. Big grey clouds rolled in. {frog:face surprised} [excited] Quick, under the {mushroom:enter} mushroom! Frog and {snail:enter} Snail {snail:pulse} squeezed in beside him, and the mushroom {mushroom:face happy} {mushroom:pulse} spread her cap wide. {canvas:rain 0.7 20s} {sfx:rain-bed} Pitter-patter, pitter-patter, down came the rain. {frog:face happy} {rabbit:face happy} [happily] Thank you, Rabbit, said Frog. {rabbit:hearts} Your ears are the best weather-watchers in the forest.

es-ES.title: Conejo oye la lluvia
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 10s} Era un día de sol, y {frog:enter} Rana {frog:hop} {frog:face sleeping} estaba tomando el sol. De pronto, {rabbit:enter} {rabbit:live} Conejo levantó las orejas. Escuchó. Miró a la izquierda, miró a la derecha… y mordisqueó una hoja de trébol, para pensar. [whispers] La oigo, dijo. Lluvia, muy, muy lejos. {sfx:far-rain solo} {frog:face normal} Rana miró al cielo. ¡Ni una nube! Pero Conejo giraba sus orejas largas hacia un lado y hacia otro. Ya viene, dijo. {canvas:clouds 0.8 30s} Y venía. Llegaron unas nubes grandes y grises. {frog:face surprised} [excited] ¡Rápido, debajo de la {mushroom:enter} seta! Rana y {snail:enter} Caracol {snail:pulse} se apretujaron a su lado, y la seta {mushroom:face happy} {mushroom:pulse} abrió bien su sombrero. {canvas:rain 0.7 20s} {sfx:rain-bed} Plic, ploc, plic, ploc, y cayó la lluvia. {frog:face happy} {rabbit:face happy} [happily] Gracias, Conejo, dijo Rana. {rabbit:hearts} Tus orejas son las mejores para saber qué tiempo va a hacer.

far-rain.prompt: very faint rain far away across a valley, a soft distant hiss

rain-bed.prompt: gentle rain pattering on big leaves and a mushroom cap
